about.title: About us
about.intro: MAIIN is an online clothing store from Syria, bringing you the latest fashion at fair prices, delivered to your door in every governorate.

sections.p: Women's, men's and kids' clothing and accessories, refreshed every week. We pick every piece carefully and check its quality before shipping.
Clear prices in dollars with the price in pounds, pay on delivery or with Sham Cash, delivery within {deliveryDays} working days, and {exchangeDays}-day exchanges if the size doesn't fit.
Have a question or an idea? We'd love to hear from you. Every way to reach us is on the Contact page.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: The MAIIN team is here to help with any question about an order, a size or a product.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what information we collect and how we use it.

sections.p: When you create an account or order, we store your name, email, mobile number and delivery address, your bag and wishlist, your orders, and payment receipt photos if you pay with Sham Cash.

We use your information to prepare and deliver your order, contact you about it, and improve our service. We don't sell your information or share it with anyone except delivery partners, only as much as delivery needs.
Your information is stored in a protected database, and each customer can only see their own. Receipt photos are kept in private storage that only you and our team can see.
You can edit your details from My account, and ask us to delete your account and information at any time by contacting us.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: By using the MAIIN website and ordering from it, you agree to these terms.

sections.p: Prices are shown in US dollars; the Syrian pound price is approximate, at the exchange rate on the day of the order. The final price is the one on your order page after confirmation.
We contact you to confirm every order before shipping. We may cancel an order if stock runs out or the contact details aren't correct, and we'll let you know if that happens.
Pay the courier on delivery, or with Sham Cash by uploading the transfer receipt. Sham Cash orders with no receipt after 24 hours are cancelled automatically.
Each code has its own conditions (minimum order, validity dates, usage limit). Only one code can be used per order.

shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.intro: We deliver to every governorate in Syria.

sections.p: Your order arrives within {deliveryDays} working days of confirmation; times may vary slightly by governorate.
Shipping is free on orders over {freeFrom}. Below that, the shipping fee is {fee}.
Follow your order at any time from My account → My orders: received, confirmed, preparing, shipped, delivered.

returns.title: Exchanges & returns
returns.intro: We want you to love every piece.

sections.p: You can exchange a size or a piece within {exchangeDays} days of delivery.
The piece must be clean, unworn and unwashed, with its tag and original packaging. Underwear and swimwear can't be exchanged for hygiene reasons.
Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and the piece you want to exchange, and we'll arrange pickup and delivery of the replacement.
If a piece arrives faulty or the order is wrong, we replace it free of charge, including shipping.

sizeGuide.howText: Chest: around the fullest part of the chest. Waist: around the narrowest point. Hip: around the fullest point. Inseam: from the top of the inner thigh to the ankle.
